summary: Frontend-only offline testing on preview URL. Verified fix for NET-after-return in both Sales history and Purchases history (grouped per supplier), plus Payments (supplier refunds labelled 'Refund', grouped per party, purchase payable ledger showing net) and new Reports screen (Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Yearly). All flows exercised via testID selectors on mobile viewport (390x844) using admin@store.com / Admin786. All acceptance criteria met — no bugs found.
test_scenarios_verified: Offline login as admin (admin@store.com / Admin786) — works with connection mode defaulted to offline (badge shows 'Live' only because health probe replied 200 from preview, but data still stored locally).
Product creation (TEST Gloves) via Stock -> add-product-fab -> product-form.
Supplier creation (TEST MedSupply) via More -> more-suppliers -> add-party-fab.
Purchase creation (10 units @ Rs 50 = Rs 500) via More -> more-purchases -> new-purchase-button.
Partial purchase return (3 units, refund Rs 150) via return-purchase-<id> -> purchase-return-form.

Purchases history verifies: supplier-group-TEST MedSupply header present, supplier-net-TEST MedSupply = 'Rs 350', purchase-net-<id> = 'Rs 350', purchase-refund-info-<id> shows original 'Rs 500' struck + '-Rs 150', purchase-returned-tag-<id> ('Returned') displayed.
Sale (2 units @ Rs 100 = Rs 200) via Sell -> add / inc -> open-cart-button -> checkout-button.
Partial sale return (1 unit, refund Rs 100) via return-sale-<id> -> return-form -> submit-return-button.
Sales list verifies: sale-net-<id> = 'Rs 100', sale-refund-info-<id> shows original 'Rs 200' struck + '-Rs 100', sale-returned-tag-<id> ('Refunded') displayed.

Payments screen: recorded supplier 'Pay' (Rs 100) and 'Supplier Refund' (Rs 50) via payment-kind-supplier_refund. party-payments-TEST MedSupply group renders both rows; refund row shows 'Refund' tag and '-Rs 50'; Payment row shows 'Payment' tag and 'Rs 100'. Purchase payable ledger shows 'Rs 350' net with 'Rs 500' struck through.

Reports screen: all 4 chips (today/week/month/year) render without crashing. Same period shows Sales(net) Rs 100, Purchases Rs 350, Returns/refunds Rs 100, Expenses Rs 0, Net profit Rs 50. Sales card correctly shows Gross Rs 200 - Returns Rs 100 = Net Rs 100.
critical_code_review_comments: Payments screen: after recording a Supplier Refund of Rs 50 the supplier outstanding balance shows Rs 300 instead of the expected Rs 200 (350 owed - 100 paid - 50 refund). This might be intentional depending on refund semantics, but should be double-checked in payments/party balance calculation in /app/frontend/src/offline.tsx (party balance mutation for supplier_refund). Not part of the reported bug — reporting for awareness only.
seed_data_creation: Created locally in offline cache during test: 1 product (TEST Gloves), 1 supplier (TEST MedSupply), 1 purchase (Rs 500, 10 units), 1 purchase return (3 units, Rs 150), 1 sale (Rs 200, 2 units), 1 sale return (1 unit, Rs 100), 2 payments (supplier refund Rs 50, pay Rs 100).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview backend Supabase not configured, but connection chip shows 'Live'. All data is created in the offline React Query cache and does not persist across page reloads, so any regression test must chain product -> supplier -> purchase -> return -> sale -> return -> payments -> reports in a single Playwright session. Use header-back-button to unwind stack screens before tab navigation to avoid 'element not visible' when clicking tab-more/tab-sell/tab-products.
